title: Down-Payment Rule for Pre-K Tuition Payment Plans
content:
**Rule.** Under the down-payment rule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a Pre-K tuition payment plan's first installment includes a down payment, paid before the rest of the open balance is divided, set by the late fees the enrollment carries in the school year:

| Late fees on the enrollment in the school year | Down payment in the first installment |
|---|---|
| two or more | 20 percent of the open balance |
| exactly one | the amount of that late fee as posted, whatever credits stand against it |
| none | no down payment; the whole open balance is divided |

The open balance is the enrollment's tuition charges, late fees and refunds less its payments and credits.

## Worked down payments (hypothetical enrollments)

| Late fees this school year | Open balance | Down payment |
|---|---|---|
| three | 900.00 | 20 percent of 900.00: 180.00 |
| one, posted at 33.00, with 20.00 already credited against it | 640.00 | 33.00, the late fee as posted |
| none | 640.00 | none |
